title: Handle an employee's visa denial or RFE
summary: The notice sets the clock. Read it first: what is questioned, the printed response deadline, and the authorization the employee holds today versus when it lapses. In the US the response window on a request for evidence is capped by regulation at twelve weeks and a notice of intent to deny at thirty days, with no extensions (law rule us-fed.rfe-noid-response-limits); the printed deadline controls. The response is one shot, so assemble the complete evidence file with immigration counsel rather than answering thinly. Premium processing, where the classification qualifies, buys adjudicative action within the designated timeframe, not approval (law rule us-fed.premium-processing-timeframe). After a denial the honest alternatives are case-specific: refiling with better evidence, a different classification (O-1 criteria sit in law rule us-fed.o1a-extraordinary-ability-criteria, cap-exempt H-1B in law rule us-fed.h1b-cap-exempt-employers), motions and appeals, or employing the person abroad through an EOR while the next petition runs. If work authorization lapses, employment must stop until reverification; that is the I-9 rule, not a judgment call (law rule us-fed.i9-reverification-employment-lapse). A founder's own stuck visa is its own situation. Educational guidance, not legal or immigration advice. Adjudication runs on the government's clock.

parts.title: Read the notice: what is questioned, the printed response deadline, and the authorization the employee holds today versus when it lapses

geoResolutions.label: The RFE or NOID prints its deadline; regulation caps the window at twelve weeks for an RFE and thirty days for a NOID, with no extensions (law rule us-fed.rfe-noid-response-limits)
Sponsor-route requests arrive through the sponsor management system and set their own deadlines

execution.rationale: Extract what the notice questions, the printed deadline, and the employee's current authorization end date from the supplied notice and petition file.

parts.title: Get immigration counsel on the response strategy the same week: a thin RFE answer is a denial with extra steps

execution.rationale: The employer and immigration counsel set the response strategy for this notice: which questions get which evidence, and what the filing posture is.

parts.title: Assemble the complete evidence file the notice actually asks for: org charts, degrees, contracts, job duties, labeled, in one pass
parts.when: The notice is an RFE or NOID with a response deadline

execution.rationale: Compile and label the requested evidence from the supplied HR and petition documents into the structure the notice asks for; counsel reviews before filing.

parts.title: Consider premium processing where the classification qualifies: it buys adjudicative action on a stated clock, not approval

execution.rationale: The employer or counsel files Form I-907 for a designated classification; USCIS must act within the designated timeframe or refund the fee, and the clock restarts when an RFE response is received.

parts.title: After a denial, map the alternatives honestly: refile with better evidence, a different classification, motions and appeals, or the role abroad

execution.rationale: The employer and counsel weigh the realistic options for this person and role; which classifications fit is a case question, not a checklist.

parts.title: Plan for the lapse like it will happen: the date work must stop, leave options, remote work from abroad, and the EOR path priced in advance

geoResolutions.label: Work must stop when authorization expires: Form I-9 reverification is due not later than the expiration date (law rule us-fed.i9-reverification-employment-lapse)
Sponsors stop employing a worker whose permission has lapsed and report the change through the sponsor management system

execution.rationale: Draft the lapse plan from the authorization dates: the last compliant workday, leave and payroll implications, and the remote or EOR options with their costs.

parts.title: If the clock wins and the role can be done abroad, keep the person: employ them through an EOR while the next petition runs
parts.when: Work authorization will lapse and the role can be performed abroad

execution.rationale: The employer decides on and starts the EOR engagement for the employee's country; the EOR process runs as its own flow.

parts.title: If the stuck case is a founder's own visa rather than an employee petition, that is its own situation
parts.when: The stuck case is the founder's own visa

execution.rationale: The founder routes the case to the matching playbook after confirming whose petition is stuck.

parts.title: Wait out the adjudication: the agency's clock restarts in full when it receives the response

execution.rationale: The employer monitors case correspondence, keeps the employee informed, and updates the lapse plan as dates move.

metadata.trigger: An RFE or a denial lands on an employee's work-visa petition, and their authorization to keep working now has a clock on it.
metadata.supportReason: Notice parsing, the evidence assembly, and the lapse-plan math are agent work from supplied documents; the counsel strategy, the filings, and the employment decisions stay with people, and adjudication runs on the government's clock.

contextNeeded.query: the RFE, NOID, or denial notice (what is questioned, the printed deadline)
the employee's current status and authorization end date, plus the petition file
